changeSet.sql: UPDATE resource SET name = TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(name, '(^|[^[:alnum:]])v[12]([^[:alnum:]]|$)', '$1$2', 1, 0, 'i')), description = CASE WHEN description IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(description, '(^|[^[:alnum:]])v[12]([^[:alnum:]]|$)', '$1$2', 1, 0, 'i')) END, location = CASE WHEN location IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(location, '(^|[^[:alnum:]])v[12]([^[:alnum:]]|$)', '$1$2', 1, 0, 'i')) END, last_modified_by = 'system', last_modified_date = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', name, description, location)) REGEXP '(^|[^[:alnum:]])v[12]([^[:alnum:]]|$)';
